
# Platform Partner Playbook

Three storefront families, three calendars, three appetites. Specs live in [[storefront-rules]]; this file is what to ask for and when.

## Console stores (PlayStation, Xbox)

**They want:** timed exclusive content, a platform feature used properly (haptics, activity cards, quick resume), a verifiable performance-mode claim, accessibility features shipped rather than promised, and a date that holds.

| Ask | Lead time |
| --- | --- |
| Front-page hero | 12 weeks |
| Carousel or themed collection slot | 8 weeks |
| Sale slot | 6 weeks |
| Asset pack due before go-live | 4 weeks |

A store-page edit costs a 5-business-day cert review; batch edits with the beat.

**Asset pack:** the console screenshot set and copy limits from [[storefront-rules]], plus hero art with its 16:9 crops, a 30s trailer *and* a 15s cut, and rating descriptors quoted verbatim.

**Blackouts:** each console showcase week and the week after (a large showcase in June, a smaller one in February), and 15 December → 5 January. The holiday calendar locks in early November.

## PC store

**They want:** fit with a fest theme, an honest discount, a large update landing on a fest day, wishlist mass, and a "what's new" page a browsing player can parse in ten seconds.

| Ask | Lead time |
| --- | --- |
| Seasonal fest participation | applications close 3 weeks before the fest |
| Homepage capsule or daily deal | 4 weeks |
| Update-visibility beat | 2 weeks |
| Sale price lock | 2 weeks ahead, unchangeable during the sale |

**Asset pack:** the PC screenshot set and copy limits from [[storefront-rules]], plus capsule art at all four store sizes and a trailer.

**Blackouts:** the two tentpole sale weeks (late June, late December), where homepage space is committed; and any fest week, for anything but the fest slot.

## Mobile stores (iOS, Android)

**They want:** a craft story (art, audio, accessibility), adoption of a new OS feature, a version shipping on OS launch day, and localization breadth.

| Ask | Lead time |
| --- | --- |
| Editorial feature | 8 weeks (6 absolute minimum) |
| "What's new" / update slot | 4 weeks |
| In-app-event card | 3 weeks |
| OS-launch-day feature | 10 weeks, and a build running on the pre-release OS |

**Asset pack:** the mobile screenshot set and copy limits from [[storefront-rules]], plus an app-preview video ≤ 30s per device class and event-card art.

**Blackouts:** each platform's developer-conference week, OS launch week, and the December holiday window.

## The pitch structure that has worked

1. One-sentence hook in their currency (exclusive / timed beat / accessibility / platform feature).
2. The confirmed date and the build it ships on.
3. What is mechanically new — two lines, no marketing adjectives.
4. Asset pack status, line by line, against their spec.
5. The ask: one named slot, one date range.
6. The fallback ask: the next-smaller slot, so the answer can be yes.

## Past Gladewick featuring outcomes

| Beat | Storefront | Slot | Duration | Outcome |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Season of the Lantern Moth (2025-06-03) | PC store | summer fest deep-dive | 3 days | 41K wishlist adds, 9% sale conversion |
| Season of the Frost Moth (2025-08-26) | console (PlayStation) | front-page carousel | 5 days | +38% day-one net bookings vs the prior season there |
| Drift Harbor `dh-1.7` (2025-10-07) | mobile (iOS) | editorial collection | 7 days | installs 2.1× that week, conversion flat |
| Season of the Ember Moth (2025-11-18) | console (Xbox) | collection slot | 4 days | +12% day-one. Hero declined for a missing 15s trailer |
| Drift Harbor `dh-1.11` (2026-02-03) | mobile (Android) | event card | 10 days | +18% returning sessions, no install lift |
| Season of the Silk Moth (2026-02-10) | PC store | homepage capsule | 2 days | +22% day-one. Pitched 5 weeks out, too late for the larger slot |

Two of the six rows are lead-time or asset-pack failures. The slot is lost before the pitch is read; pitch with the pack complete, or pitch the smaller slot.
